SELECT s.schedule_seq AS scheduleSeq, s.trainno AS trainNo, s.depplacename AS depPlaceName, s.arrplacename AS arrPlaceName, s.depplandtime AS depPlandTime, s.arrplandtime AS arrPlandTime, s.booking_open_at AS bookingOpenAt, s.first_price AS firstPrice, s.standard_price AS standardPrice, s.status, ds.nodename AS depStationName, as2.nodename AS arrStationName, t.vehiclekndnm AS vehicleKndNm, t.line_category AS lineCategory, (935 - ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM seat st WHERE st.schedule_seq = s.schedule_seq )) AS availableSeats FROM schedule s LEFT JOIN station ds ON s.depplacename = ds.nodeid LEFT JOIN station as2 ON s.arrplacename = as2.nodeid LEFT JOIN train t ON s.trainno = t.trainno WHERE s.schedule_seq = #{scheduleSeq}
